idx_titulo: DM Atelier, 3D-printed nail technician accessories by Dayse Marques
idx_desc: Organisers and displays for nail technicians, designed by nail educator Dayse Marques, 3D-printed to order and engraved with your salon's name.
hero_h1: Nail polish organisers engraved with your salon's name
hero_chapo: The kit from my training table, made for yours. I'm Dayse Marques, nail technician and educator, and I design the organisers I use with my students. Every piece is 3D-printed to order, in Belgium.
hero_essai: Try it with your salon's name
hero_alt: Nail polish organiser with three tiers and fifteen slots, the salon name engraved on the front step.
col_p: Pieces designed for the workstation: everything stays in place, in sight, and in your name.
col_alt: Three organiser modules joined side by side, forty-five slots in total.
col_li1: 15 bottles per module, on three tiers
col_li2: Modules slot together to extend the storage
col_li3: Your salon's name engraved on the front step
etapas_p: No account needed. Ordering takes a few messages.
e1_p: Choose the size, the colour and the name to engrave on the product page.
e2_p: The button writes the message with your choices. All you do is send it.
e3_p: We confirm the total with shipping and send you a payment link for card, Bancontact or iDEAL.
e4_p: Your piece is printed after payment and shipped to Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany or Austria.
msg_aria: Example of the message the site prepares
msg_exemplo:
Hello DM Atelier! I would like to order:
Tiered nail polish organiser, 2 modules (30 bottles)
Colour: Champagne
Engraving: "Studio Léa", classic style
Price shown: €74 incl. VAT
dayse_aria: DM monogram, the one engraved on the pieces
dayse_h2: Why a nail educator designs her own tools
dayse_p1: In a training session, every minute spent looking for a bottle is a minute less for technique. I wanted a table where students see everything at a glance.
dayse_p2: What you find here was first used in my salon in Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont. If a piece can't last a working day, it doesn't make the collection.
dayse_assinatura: Dayse Marques, nail technician and educator
faq1_r: Every piece is printed to order. Allow 5 to 8 working days of production after payment, plus shipping.
faq2_q: Where do you ship and how much does it cost?
faq2_r: We ship to Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany and Austria. Shipping depends on the country and the weight. We give you the price on WhatsApp before payment.
faq3_r: Once your order is confirmed, you receive a secure payment link: bank card, Bancontact or iDEAL. Printing starts after payment.
faq4_r: A piece engraved with your name is made for you and can't be returned, unless it is faulty. A piece without engraving can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
faq5_r: Ivory, champagne, brown and black. For another colour, ask us on WhatsApp.

lm_1: The DM Atelier website is published by Dayse Marques, sole trader, company number BE0777645238, Rue des Champs d'en Haut 26, 7160 Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont, Belgium.
lm_2: Contact: on WhatsApp, through the buttons on the site.
lm_3: Hosting: Netlify, Inc., 512 2nd Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States.
c_pedido: You order by WhatsApp message from the product page. The order is binding once DM Atelier confirms the total, shipping included, and payment is received.
c_preco: Prices are in euros, VAT included. Shipping costs are given before payment. Payment is made through a secure link (bank card, Bancontact or iDEAL) or by bank transfer.
c_fab: Every piece is printed after payment. The production time is shown on the product page. We deliver to Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany and Austria.
c_retr1: For a piece without personalisation, you have 14 days after delivery to withdraw without giving a reason. Return costs are yours to pay, and the refund is made within 14 days of receiving the return.
c_retr2: A piece that is engraved or made to your choices is produced to your specifications and is not covered by the right of withdrawal (Article VI.53, 3° of the Belgian Code of Economic Law).
c_gar: All pieces carry the two-year legal guarantee of conformity. If a piece is faulty, message us on WhatsApp with a photo.
c_lit: Belgian law applies. In case of disagreement, you can contact the Belgian Consumer Ombudsman Service (consumerombudsman.be).
p_1: The site sets no cookies. Visits are measured with GoatCounter, without cookies and without data that identifies you.
p_2: When you order, we receive your name, your number, your delivery address and the text to engrave on WhatsApp. This data is used only to make, deliver and invoice your order. Invoices are kept for 7 years, as the law requires.
p_3: WhatsApp is a Meta service with its own privacy policy. Payment is handled by the provider of the payment link.
p_4: You can ask on WhatsApp to access, correct or delete your data. You can also file a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (dataprotectionauthority.be).
